scope: Actual production route, keyboard and pointer actions in isolated Chrome 9238; no authentication or database writes.

checks.name: Atlas controls are sibling buttons with no delayed native titles
Every visible details arrow retains a 44×44 target
Keyboard focus instantly exposes full tooltip and description association
Escape dismisses the focused tooltip without losing focus
Enter on a parent explores its children and focuses the atlas heading
Enter on the independent arrow opens that category’s details and focuses its title
Resizing preserves the focused tile and keyboard tooltip
Pointer hover shows tooltip immediately without a delay
Scrolling dismisses the previous hover tooltip
Movement within the same tile restores tooltip after scrolling
Tooltip remains clamped inside the viewport
Escape remains dismissed during subsequent movement within that tile
Leaving and re-entering makes the tooltip available again
Navigating away cleans up the atlas tooltip
No runtime exceptions during the production integration checks
